curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8203-1-1.pdf (two pages: the yellow chassis steps 1-6, the black arm with its hose roll cage steps 1-5, then the two put together, steps 6-8)

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely, each on its own pin in the yellow chassis; there's no steering.
functions.source: book: chassis step 4 (the pins), final steps 7-8 (the wheels)

functions.does: The black arm carrying the hose roll cage tilts on the 4-long axle through the middle of the yellow chassis: pressing the cage's nose down lifts the arm's back end, with its yellow hose connectors, off the chassis.
functions.source: inferred: final steps 6-7 drop the arm between the chassis beams and push the axle through both; the book draws no motion, and it's a guess from the band in step 6 that the nose is meant to be pressed down
functions.note: the back of the arm rests its hose connectors (p23 32013, p24 32013) on the chassis beams, so the nose can only go down from where it is built, not up

functions.does: The rubber band, looped round the two 3/4 pins on the chassis sides and under the black arm just in front of its axle, springs the cage's nose back up when it's let go.
functions.source: inferred: chassis steps 5-6 and the band's place in the model file, which runs under the arm; the book draws no motion
functions.skip: a spring: it only pushes the arm back, which Kinebrick doesn't simulate yet
